maddeler.e:
أنتقم (form VIII)
# أَنْتَقِمُ (ʔantaqimu) /ʔan.ta.qi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَمَ (intaqama)
# أَنْتَقِمَ (ʔantaqima) /ʔan.ta.qi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَمَ (intaqama)
# أَنْتَقِمْ (ʔantaqim) /ʔan.ta.qim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَقَمَ (intaqama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
